navigation: Choose a campaign location, then City Runs, Road Runs, Detours, or Raceways. Each optional event is assigned to its nearest main campaign location. Existing main progression is unchanged.
durationModel: Curvature-limited winter planning pace, not a measured AI lap; car, conditions and driver change the result. Circuit estimates include all three laps.
limitations: Road centerlines and tagged lane widths come from OpenStreetMap; missing widths use the existing importer defaults. These are not surveyed racing surfaces.
DEM ground elevations are approximate; mapped bridge decks interpolate between approaches. Coastal terrain-only DEM no-data uses sea level and is listed in each affected source document.
City races are fictional closed-road events following mapped local streets and one-way directions; turn-restriction relations and temporary construction are not modeled.
Landmark distances are nearest-road projections on the native timed route. Existing generic buildings dress cities; the 200 landmark-specific graphics have not been created.
Untimed approaches/runouts are explicitly authored fictional service roads, not additional surveyed GPS geometry.
